# Fourier transform

The Fourier transform, inverse normalization, derivative and shift rules,
convolution theorem, Gaussian heat kernel, and DFT sampling limits are developed
in [Fourier analysis](fourier-series.qmd#the-fourier-transform-and-its-normalization).
That chapter also explains conversion between angular wavenumber $k$ and cyclic
frequency $\xi=k/(2\pi)$, so factors of $2\pi$ remain paired with the chosen measure.
